_ordering_rationale: American Tower = REIT tours communication. US&C dominant (52% CA), Latam, Africa, Europe + Data Centers (acquisition CoreSite 2022).

kpis.signal: 52% CA Amer Tower, marche le plus mature, croissance ralentie post-resiliations Sprint/T-Mobile
kpis.description_fr: Property revenue segment U.S. & Canada (~52% CA total). Marche le plus mature, ralenti FY24 par resiliations Sprint/T-Mobile post-fusion. Croissance organique ~3-4% retrouvee 2025+.
kpis.description_en: U.S. & Canada property revenue (~52% of total). Most mature market, slowed FY24 by Sprint/T-Mobile post-merger churn. ~3-4% organic growth expected 2025+.

kpis.signal: FY24 inclut Africa & APAC consolides post vente ATC India, croissance Afrique sub-sah forte mais FX defavorable
kpis.description_fr: Africa property revenue. FY24 reclassifie Africa & APAC ensemble (post vente ATC India $2.5 Mds a Brookfield). Croissance organique Afrique sub-sah forte 5G/data, freinee FX.
kpis.description_en: Africa property revenue. FY24 reclassifies Africa & APAC together (post ATC India $2.5B sale to Brookfield). Strong sub-Saharan organic growth on 5G/data, FX headwind.

kpis.signal: Marche Brasil + Mexique, croissance moderee + impact FX
kpis.description_fr: Latin America property revenue (Brazil, Mexique, Argentine, Chili, Peru, Colombie). Impact FX defavorable FY23-FY24 sur croissance reportee.
kpis.description_en: Latin America property revenue (Brazil, Mexico, Argentina, Chile, Peru, Colombia). Adverse FX impact FY23-FY24 on reported growth.

kpis.signal: Acquisition CoreSite Dec 2021 $10.1 Mds, ~9% CA en croissance 10%+ portee par hyperscalers + IA
kpis.description_fr: Data Centers revenue (CoreSite acquis Dec 2021 pour 10.1 Mds $). 28 data centers US tier-1. Croissance +10% via demande IA/hyperscalers/cloud.
kpis.description_en: Data Centers revenue (CoreSite acquired Dec 2021 for $10.1B). 28 US tier-1 data centers. +10% growth via AI/hyperscaler/cloud demand.

kpis.signal: Europe en montee via acquisition Telxius Towers FY21 (~30k sites Espagne/Allemagne), expansion 5G
kpis.description_fr: Europe property revenue. Expansion via acquisition Telxius Towers ($7.6 Mds, ~30k sites Espagne/Allemagne) finalisee 2021. Croissance via deploiement 5G.
kpis.description_en: Europe property revenue. Expansion via Telxius Towers acquisition ($7.6B, ~30k Spain/Germany sites) completed 2021. Growth from 5G deployment.

kpis.signal: Plateau ~10 Mds $, vente ATC India + headwinds FX/MNO neutres net positif
kpis.description_fr: Total revenues consolide. Plateau ~10 Mds $, vente ATC India FY24 reduit reported revenu mais ameliore qualite portefeuille.
kpis.description_en: Total consolidated revenue. ~$10B plateau, FY24 ATC India sale reduces reported revenue but improves portfolio quality.

_notes: Donnees 10-K American Tower Corp FY20-FY24. Data Centers history demarre FY22 (acquisition CoreSite Dec 2021). Africa+APAC consolide FY24 post-vente Inde. Total Revenues FY23/FY24 = pre/post ATC India deconsolidation.
